public class SudokuModel extends Object implements ISudokuModel
Concrete implementation of ISudokuModel for a 6Ã—6 Sudoku puzzle.

Data structures used (beyond plain arrays)

  • ArrayList<Integer> â€” holds a shuffled candidate list inside generateSolution(int, int) to ensure a different random board every run. Also used in getRandomEmptyCell() to collect and shuffle empty cells.
  • Deque<int[]> â€” stores the undo history. Every call to setValue(int, int, int) pushes the previous [row, col, value] triple so the user can step back through their moves.

      public int[] getRandomEmptyCell()
      Selects a random empty (value = 0) cell on the current board.

      Uses an ArrayList to collect all empty cells and then shuffles the list so the returned cell is always random.
